headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 4, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 24.37%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.82%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 10.55%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also ahead of the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved a remarkable return of 47.07%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 18.03%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during times of market uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
